description: 麵攤阿婆（ah_po）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 麵攤阿婆

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. an elderly noodle stall owner, a lean weathered woman in her seventies, about six heads tall, slightly stooped: a sharp tired face with deep lines and a sceptical squint, thin grey hair pulled back in a messy bun with loose strands, a faded olive-grey long-sleeved top with sleeves pushed up and a patched elbow, a long stained dark-blue cotton apron with a big front pocket and a grease-spotted hem, baggy dark trousers, worn slip-on shoes, a small neon-orange tag clipped to the apron. Empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face.
